name: Alvopetro Energy Ltd.
summary: Alvopetro Energy Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of hydrocarbons in Brazil and Canada. The company holds interests in the Caburé and Murucututu natural gas assets; Block 183 exploration block; TUC-T-142, TUC-T-151, and TUC-T-174 exploration blocks; Subauma Mirim, a marginal field; and Bom Lugar and Mãe-da-lua oil fields comprising approximately 2,671 acres located in the Recôncavo basin onshore Brazil. Alvopetro Energy Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
